en: The image shows a historic European town square with prominent old buildings. The main building is labeled 'HOTEL goldne Sonne', and nearby are other businesses with German signage. The street is cobbled, and a few people can be seen walking. The image is monochrome, giving it an antique feel, typical of early 20th-century postcards. The caption at the top reads 'Lommatzsch. Am Markt.' and at the bottom '7037. Brück & Sohn, Meissen.'
